1.label: controls
1.script_code:
(output gain f64)
(output freq f64)

(define gain (store-get "gain"))
(define freq (store-get "freq"))

# Controls

@(slider "gain" 0.0 100.0)
@(slider "freq" 1.0 20.0)
@(checkbox "Enabled" "enabled")
@(text-input "label" "Enter label...")

---

Gain = @(store-get "gain"), Freq = @(store-get "freq")

2.label: wave
2.script_code:
(input gain f64)
(input freq f64)

(define pi 3.14159265)
(define (make-wave n)
  (if (= n 0) '()
    (cons (* gain (sin (* freq (/ n 10.0) pi)))
          (make-wave (- n 1)))))
(define data (make-wave 40))

# Waveform

@(plot-line data "signal")

Peak = @gain, Frequency = @freq

3.label: tasks
3.script_code:
# Task Manager

@(text-input "new-task" "New task...")
@(button "Add Task" (store-append! "tasks" (store-get "new-task")))

---

Stored tasks: @(store-get "tasks")
